text_en: “Do you think this to be just? You say, ‘I am in the right before God. ’
text_cn: 你说过：“我在天主前是正义的。”你想这话合理吗？

text_en: If you ask, ‘What advantage have I? How am I better off than if I had sinned? ’
text_cn: 你还说过：“这与你何干？我若犯罪，我对你做了什么？”

text_en: I will answer you and your friends with you.
text_cn: 我今答复你，以及和你在一起的友人。

text_en: Look at the heavens and see; observe the clouds, which are higher than you.
text_cn: 请你仰视上天，且要静观，细看高于你的苍天。

text_en: If you have sinned, what do you accomplish against him? And if your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
text_cn: 你若犯罪，为他有什么害处？你若作恶多端，又能加害他什么？

text_en: If you are righteous, what do you give to him; or what does he receive from your hand?
text_cn: 如果你为人正义，为他又有何益？或者他由你手中获得什么？

text_en: Your wickedness affects others like you, and your righteousness, other human beings.
text_cn: 你的恶行只能加害与你类似的人，你的正义也只能有益于世人。

text_en: “Because of the multitude of oppressions people cry out; they call for help because of the arm of the mighty.
text_cn: 人因受暴虐过甚，必要哀号；因受强权的压迫，必要呼吁。

text_en: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives strength in the night,
text_cn: 但是没有人说：“那造成我们，使人夜间欢唱，

text_en: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the air? ’
text_cn: 使我们比地上的走兽更聪明，使我们比天上的飞鸟更有智慧的天主在哪里？”

text_en: There they cry out, but he does not answer, because of the pride of evildoers.
text_cn: 他们虽呼喊，天主却不答应，这是因为恶人傲慢的原故。

text_en: Surely God does not hear an empty cry, nor does the Almighty regard it.
text_cn: 他们空喊乱叫，天主决不俯听，全能者决不垂视。

text_en: How much less when you say that you do not see him, that the case is before him, and you are waiting for him!
text_cn: 何况你说过：“你看不见他；但你的案件已放在他面前，你应等待他！”

text_en: And now, because his anger does not punish, and he does not greatly heed transgression,
text_cn: 你还说过：“他没有发怒施罚，似乎不很理会罪过。”

text_en: Job opens his mouth in empty talk, he multiplies words without knowledge. ”
text_cn: 的确，约伯开口尽说空话；由于无知，说了许多妄言。
